description: This Java class implements Blowfish encryption and decryption for byte arrays and strings, including key generation, serialization, and file-based key storage. It provides methods for encrypting/decrypting data and testing key validity.

classes.name: BlowFishCrypt
classes.description: A class providing symmetric encryption and decryption using the Blowfish algorithm with support for key generation and key management.

methods.name: BlowFishCrypt
methods.description: Constructs a BlowFishCrypt instance with a given SecretKeySpec, or from a key file, or from a byte array.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string or byte array using Blowfish.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted string or byte array back to original form.

methods.name: crypt
methods.description: Performs the actual encryption or decryption operation with specified mode.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a new 448-bit Blowfish secret key.

methods.name: testKey
methods.description: Tests if a given key correctly encrypts and decrypts a test string.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for generating and storing a new encrypted key.
